inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev6 template-free root/scene compilation, dev5 multi-bone/CUBICSPLINE animation, dev4 MOTN/ANIM creation, dev3 TEX synthesis, dev2 schema synthesis, dev1 integrated mod staging, and earlier GMX graph/native-builder/source-only gates are inherited. dev7 adds evidence-bounded rigid glTF skin compatibility without inventing per-vertex native weight semantics.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 81/81 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Rigid glTF skin compatibility is structurally regression-tested and constrained to one unit-weight joint shared by the whole mesh; true blended/multi-joint weights are not encoded because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.
Selected non-identity inverse-bind matrices are rejected in dev7; geometry rebaking through inverse bind transforms remains future work.
MESH.skin_index remains semantically unresolved beyond the repeated corpus-observed 0xFFFF no-vertex-skin value and is not repurposed as a glTF skin index.
Template-free GMX creation remains structurally regression-tested; arbitrary original scenes still require emulator/hardware runtime validation.
Platform shader microcode compilation remains unresolved; SHAD synthesis covers fixed metadata only.

The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX no-op evidence remains inherited; dev7 separately re-ran player/enemy skin-field/vertex-semantic statistics on user-supplied proprietary inputs without bundling them.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
